trackExam.title: Course final exam
trackExam.intro: A timed exam covering the whole course. Pass it and you get a certificate with a public address anyone can check.
trackExam.coverage: Questions are spread across the modules in proportion to their skills, so the exam covers the whole course rather than one corner of it.
trackExam.perSkillCaveat: Each row carries its correct-out-of-total. With two or three questions, one answer moves the percentage far more than it says about you.
trackExam.expired: Submitted after time. We marked it anyway so you can see how you did, but it does not count towards the certificate.

testOut.title: Skip this module
testOut.intro: Show you already know this module and move on without working through it.
testOut.honesty: Every skill in the module gets the same number of questions. Passing does not hand you the module: each answer goes to the engine, and your mastery rises exactly as far as what you showed.
testOut.failedHelp: No harm done: your progress is exactly where it was. Work through the module and come back whenever you like.
testOut.noCertificate: Skipping a module does not earn a certificate. The certificate comes from the course final exam.

landing.metaTitle: Whetzy — Python, AI and cybersecurity with an adaptive engine
landing.heroTitle: Learn Python, AI and cybersecurity right at the edge of what you already know.
landing.heroBody: An adaptive engine (BKT + FSRS + Elo) picks every question from your real mastery, you code in the browser with nothing to install, and you prepare for certifications with readiness measured per exam domain. In English and in Spanish.
landing.heroShotAlt: Real Whetzy session screen: a Python question with two options
landing.codeComment: # your last answer: correct in 4.1 s

f1.title: A genuinely adaptive engine
f1.body: Every answer updates your mastery probability per skill. The next question aims at a 75 % success rate: not so easy it bores you, not so hard it makes you quit. Reviews arrive just as memory starts to fade.

f2.title: Code that actually runs
f2.body: Python, SQL and JavaScript run in your browser with nothing to install. Fill the blank, run it and see the real output.

f3.title: Certification prep you can measure
f3.body: Timed mock exams with the official exam's domain mix, and per-domain readiness that tells you what is missing before you pay the exam fee.

landing.howTitle: From zero to proving it, in three steps.

s1.title: Placement
s1.body: An adaptive placement test finds what you already know and lets you skip whole modules.

s2.title: Short adaptive sessions
s2.body: Ten-question sessions that mix new material with the reviews that are due. Every mistake comes with an explanation and a cited source.

s3.title: Prove what you know
s3.body: Pass a course's final exam and get a certificate with a public address anyone can verify.
